scientific_scan.expected_scope: full saved timeline sidecar; QI/QN/QE remain unknown

initial_frame.scope: bounded source/identity/units check only; no label materialization

observation_definition.initial_quality_denominator: all CURRENT-bound initial_type==fluid identities, including initially invalid identities; use initial_mass only
observation_definition.identity_axis: typed (Zone,Idp), fixed over saved frames; no arbitrary particle ordering or glob-derived cohort

missing_and_invalid.valid_false: missing/censored; retain its initial mass in the denominator
missing_and_invalid.active_nonfinite_velocity: reject event speed observation; do not emit observed relative speed
missing_and_invalid.birth_or_revival: unknown/unsupported until explicit lineage is bound

observation_definition.time: saved frame times from CURRENT trajectory; first passage is saved bracket plus linear signed-distance chord estimate
observation_definition.motion_surface: signed distance to the surface pose at each endpoint; translating/rotating surface motion must be explicitly bound
event_semantics: forward and backward crossings are separate
multiple crossings are retained per event axis
first passage is censored when no valid crossing is observed
first-passage state is one of observed, right_censored, failed_before_observation, initially_inside, ambiguous_multiple_crossing
each event retains typed (Zone,Idp), saved brackets, and hidden-recross status
hidden recrossings between saved frames remain unresolved
residence uses valid paired intervals and reports unresolved interval time
observation_definition.source_assignment: initial native_mk or explicitly reviewed initial source geometry; no fixed legacy case list

manufactured_reference.use: operator implementation check only; never transferred as scientific qualification

steps: freeze this definition and source hashes before any native read
run the approved initial-frame identity/units/mass check on a bounded window
replay a parent-approved bounded native window with the same operator and record residuals plus censor/unknown counts
compare an independently bound source or reference only after source/control/geometry roles agree
register any native tolerance as a new immutable profile; do not widen it after observing results
keep QI/QN/QE UNKNOWN until the parent qualification review accepts all required evidence

no_qualification_from: native exclusion absence or zero exclusion count

lineage_policy.audit_scope: all 336 CURRENT rows and their bound manifest JSONs
lineage_policy.cross_resolution_or_rerun: connect only with declared canonical physical-condition evidence; XML/numerical hash alone is insufficient
lineage_policy.control_and_geometry: require explicit bound control_family/geometry evidence; absent fields remain UNKNOWN

native_exclusion.note: F2-S1 has native receipt and RunPARTs accounting, but no exact native-exclusion-ledger.json; F2H10V2 ledgers are intentionally not reused

now: selected manifest and small provenance JSONs
selected XML/control file and declared motion file
read_scope.later_request: parent stage2guard-approved bounded frame window only

resource_plan.metadata_probe_storage: <5 MiB generated bundle plus JSON inputs; no HDF5 copy
resource_plan.initial_frame_request_cpu: 1 core; bounded sample only after parent slot
